fields.incidentName: Milford Regional Medical Center - EHR Downtime
fields.name: Priya Natarajan

entries.activity: EHR and PACS unavailable house-wide. Downtime procedures declared by AOC.
HICS activated. Assumed Planning Section Chief. Unit leaders assigned.
IT reports ransom note on three Citrix servers. Network segmented at core.
Downtime census printed from BCA workstations: 214 inpatients, 31 in ED.
IAP for OP 1 started. Objectives from IC: patient safety, diversion decision by 1000.
Lab results now by runner and fax; turnaround 70 min vs 25 normal.
Pharmacy: automated dispensing cabinets on override. Paper MAR in use on all units.
FBI Cleveland Field Office and HHS notified by CISO. Insurer hotline called.
IC decision: ED on diversion for ambulance traffic except STEMI/stroke.
Situation report #1 sent to County EOC and the regional healthcare coalition.
Media inquiry from Channel 5 routed to PIO. Holding statement approved.
IT estimate: EHR restore from backups not before 0600 tomorrow. OP 2 planning started.
